The detailed tile JSON files are an adapted database of the bounded extract described in provenance.json.
The regional packs in region/ are an adapted database of the wider BBBike Seoul extract. See regional-provenance.json for its coverage, checksum, and derivation.
The driving map and the water layer in the regional packs also include OpenStreetMap data distributed by OpenFreeMap using OpenMapTiles. The water source tiles, selected landmarks, and individual bridge references are listed in driving-map-sources.json.
https://openfreemap.org/
https://openmaptiles.org/
